fit.instructions: Rate candidate suitability for this job. Read mandatory requirements, including the end of the posting. Explicitly missing mandatory qualifications must lower the rating, even when other skills fit.
criteria: No match: unrelated profession, missing required license, or explicitly insufficient mandatory language level
Low match: core mandatory professional experience is missing
Partial match: some useful experience but an important requirement is missing or unknown
Strong match: mandatory core background is evidenced with only minor optional gaps
Very strong match: relevant professional experience and all stated mandatory qualifications are clearly evidenced

mandatory_match.instructions: Does this candidate satisfy the job mandatory professional qualifications, technical experience and language level? If a mandatory qualification is explicitly absent or insufficient, answer false.

language_match.instructions: Does the candidate meet the mandatory German language level in the posting? C1 satisfies C1; A1 is below C1.
